headline: From LPG to UPI: These changes set to take place in October | These changes regarding LPG, UPI, and more are set to take place in October.
summary: Several changes are set to take effect as October begins, covering LPG, UPI and other areas. The changes could have a direct impact on household spending.
why: LPG is cooking gas widely used by Indian households, and UPI is the country's dominant instant mobile payments system run by NPCI. Changes to either affect consumer costs and the digital payments ecosystem.
